consensus_strengths: The frozen case has exceptional artifact integrity and offline auditability: hashes, raw shards, source provenance, cardinalities, relational checks, and deterministic memory equations are mutually consistent.
The manuscript generally scopes its result responsibly as same-implementation self-consistency, not semantic correctness, throughput, service capacity, or cross-runtime generalization.
The page-pool accounting is transparent, and the separation of logical pools, allocator counters, and unmeasured service-level capacity is valuable.
Presentation, anonymity, build quality, and claim/evidence organization are strong.
consensus_weaknesses: The reported 1.0398x allocator result is a post-pack production-phase peak, not the maximum over the recorded lifecycle; the natural lifecycle calculation is 1.0306x at N=32.

The recurrent GDN ownership claim is only partially witnessed: request storage identities are not archived, request-to-persistent-base disjointness is not tested, and both arms use the same GDN strategy.
No independent semantic oracle or executed runtime mutation study demonstrates that the checklist detects realistic ownership faults or common-mode errors.
The package replays hashes and booleans but cannot independently regenerate the central tensor equalities from a clean pinned environment.
Novelty and significance remain narrow: one model/runtime/geometry and serial lifecycle, with no invariant-level proof of distinction from closest work or transfer to another system.

positions: The reproducibility reviewer scores 6, emphasizing unusually complete offline provenance and replay.
Four reviewers score 4, emphasizing scientific validation, novelty, and claim/evidence gaps.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Use 4: artifact quality is a major strength, but it does not resolve the phase-mislabeled allocator claim, incomplete GDN witness, absent fault-sensitivity evidence, or narrow contribution.

positions: Some review language treats 1.0398x as a responsibly reported absolute allocator ratio.
Two high-confidence reviews reconstruct it as phase-local and obtain a 1.0306x full-recorded-lifecycle ratio.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Treat 1.0398x as supported only for the explicitly named post-pack production window and report the lifecycle maximum separately.

positions: Most reviewers cap the present evidence at 6 or lower.
The experiments reviewer predicts 8 only after extensive new oracle, mutation, GDN-factorial, lifecycle, transfer, and rerun evidence.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Keep the current-evidence ceiling at 6; consider 8 only after the proposed new evidence is actually reviewed.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: Calling the 1.0398x quantity a whole-allocator result is not supported by the phase records summarized by EXP-01 and R02-SND-01; it is a post-pack production-window result.

prioritized_actions.description: Define the allocator window, relabel 1.0398x as post-pack production peak, and report the recorded lifecycle maximum of 1.0306x consistently.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: All text, figures, tables, and claim maps reproduce both series from phase records without mixing them.

prioritized_actions.description: Archive replayable GDN request/request and request/base ranges, test alias mutants and a GDN control; otherwise narrow all hybrid-ownership claims to fixed-GDN KV ownership.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Offline replay proves all storage relations and injected aliases fail, or no headline claims full recurrent ownership.

prioritized_actions.description: Add an independent semantic subset and executed mutation-by-check matrix for KV aliasing, tail COW, GDN aliasing, positions/masks, and fallback paths.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Clean runs pass; each preregistered mutant fails its intended target; raw outcomes are replayable.

prioritized_actions.description: Provide a pinned, path-independent clean rerun and one-command headless replay, including public input reconstruction and provenance-ledger reconciliation.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: An independent clean environment regenerates the central equality records, corrected memory metrics, and aggregate.

prioritized_actions.description: Define ForkAudit as one contribution type, bound novelty to verified traceability, map targets to prior capabilities, and unify arm names and sampling units.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Every headline maps uniquely to a reusable protocol output or frozen-case finding, with no unverified transfer claim.

acceptance_condition: At least a score-6 revision must correct the allocator estimand, make recurrent ownership claims match direct evidence, demonstrate runtime fault sensitivity or an independent oracle, enable independent numerical rerun, and establish a precise invariant-level contribution boundary.

stop_condition_assessment.reason: The median score is 4 and several concrete, high-confidence blockers remain; both current-evidence corrections and decisive new experiments are available, so further revision is warranted.
